chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin a hong sapna thupha note in na ngah uh tawh kituakin na zuih nadingun, Topa hanga thongkia keimah in hansuahin kong zol hi.
Na khempeuh panin kiniamsakna tawh, lungnemna tawh, lungduaina tawh dimin, itna lungsim tawh khat leh khat kithuakin,
kilem a, kipawlin, kikhopna hangin note in Kha Siangtho hanga na ngah uh pum khat bek ahihna na zuih nadingun na hahkat un.
Note hong sapna lametna khat bek hangah hong koih ahih mah bangin, pumpi khat, Kha Siangtho khat bek a om hi.
Topa khat bek, upna khat bek, baptaizna khat bek, mi khempeuh tungah a om, mi khempeuh lakah a kizeel, mi khempeuh sungah a om, mi khempeuh’ Pa ahi Pasian khat bek a om hi.
Ahih hangin Khazih in a hong hawm sak mah bangin i vekpi-in a hehpihna thupha i ngah ciat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho in: “A sang munah amah a kahtoh ciangin, mi tampi manin paipih a, mite kiangah thupha letsong a pia hi,” a ci hi.
“Amah a kahtoh”, a cih ciangin lei nuai-ah a kumsuk thu ngaihsunin ci hilo hiam?
A kumsuk mi in midang ahi kei hi, na khempeuh a kicing sak dingin, vantung na khempeuhte a dawn khengin a kahto mi ahi hi.

Khazih’ pumpi lamin nasep nading ahi zongin, misiangtho kipsak nading ahi zongin amah in mi kimkhatte sawltak za ahi zongin, mi kimkhat kamsang za ahi zongin, mi kimkhat Lungdamna Thu, thuhilh za ahi zongin, mi kimkhat pawlpi kem Sia za leh laihilh za ahi zongin a koih hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite khempeuh in thu-upna lamah ahi zongin, Pasian’ Tapa theihna ah ahi zongin, kipum khatin Khazih’ kicin’na lim mun ahi, a khangham mi suahna i tun’ dongin i piang hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi dangte in mi kheemna mawhna lamah zol dingin, kheemna thu gen ahih ciangun, eite in a nung ciangin thuhilhna khempeuh ah huih in a let kawikawi naupang suak loin,
itna tawh thuman thutak geninah lutang ahi Khazih dongin na khempeuh i khan’ nading ahi hi.
Tua lutang pan guh-le-tangte in thahatna ngahin, a pumpi khempeuh kizom kimatin, na khempeuh in amau nasep tek a sep mah bangin, itna tawh ama pumpi lam dingin a khang sak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gentailte in a lungsim kiphatsakna uh tawh a gamtat bangun note in na gamtat nawn loh nadingun Topa’ deihna bangin thuumin kong hanthawn hi.
Tua mite in a lungsim uh khauh a, neu kha beek thei lo ahih ciangun pilna khuavak kiliahin Pasian’ nuntakna tawh a kikhen uh hi.
Amaute in maizumna nei lo uh a, a deihgawhna uh a lian mahmah kihhuai gamtatna nam khempeuh a gamtat nadingun, amau pumpi in a lunggulhna uh khut sungah a kipia uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua bang suah nading note in Khazih thu na sin kei uh hi.

Nidang lai-inah na gamtatna uhah a hong khem thei huaihamna lungsim hangin a muat thei mi lui suahkhia-in lungsim ngaihsutna thak na ngah khit uh ciangin, thuman thutak tawh kipawl dikna leh siangthona hangin Pasian tawh a kibanga kibawl mi thak na silh nadingun Zeisu’ thu na zak na ngaih uh ciangin, Zeisu-a thuman thutak a om mah bangin tua Topa kiangah thu na sin un.
Tua ahih ciangin zuau thu paaikhia un la, thuman thutak tawh khat leh khat na kigen un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in pumpi khat’ nate ciat i hi hi.
Hehna tawh khialhna om sak kei un. Na hehna uh dam loin ni na tum sak kei un.
Dawimangpa hun na pia kei un.
Nidang lai-a guta mi in gu nawn loin, sapna neite a hop zawh, a piak zawh nadingin ama khut tawh nasepna a hoih hahkatin sem ta hen.
Nomau kam sungpan kam hoih lo khat beek pusuak kei hen. A za mite phattuamna a piang sak dingin, a sapna bangin a kipsak nadingin kam hoih na zang un.
Tatna’ Ni a tun’ dongin note hong ciamtehna ahi Pasian’ Kha Siangtho na dah sak kei un.
Kimuhdahna khempeuh, hehna khempeuh, thangpaihna khempeuh, han’sanna khempeuh, mindai nading mi gensiatna khempeuh, hazatna khempeuhte note kiang pan na paaikhia un!
Khat leh khat na kihehpih un, thupha na kibawl un la, Khazih’ hangah Pasian in na mawhna uh hong maisak mah bangin note khat leh khat mawhna kimaisak un.
